title.sr: Utisak klijenta - od slanja do odobravanja
title.en: A customer review - from sending to approval

intro.sr: Posetilac ostavlja utisak na početnoj strani, a administrator ga u „Testimoniali“ proverava i odobrava; tek tada postaje javan.
intro.en: A visitor leaves a review on the home page, and an administrator checks and approves it in “Testimoniali”; only then does it become public.

admin-testimoniali-otvara-meni.en: We open the “Sadržaj i marketing” group.

utisak-forma.sr: Na početnoj strani (i na stranicama usluga, paketa i proizvoda) posetilac može da ostavi utisak.
utisak-forma.en: On the home page (and on service, package and product pages) a visitor can leave a review.

utisak-ime.sr: Upisuje ime koje će biti prikazano uz utisak.
utisak-ime.en: They type the name shown with the review.

utisak-ocena.sr: Bira ocenu od jedne do pet zvezdica.
utisak-ocena.en: They choose a rating from one to five stars.

utisak-poruka.en: They write the review, at least 10 characters.

utisak-pristanak.sr: Pristanak za javno prikazivanje je obavezan.
utisak-pristanak.en: Consent to publish it is required.

utisak-slanje.sr: {Kliknemo} „Pošalji utisak“. Utisak ne postaje javan odmah: čeka proveru.
utisak-slanje.en: We {click} “Pošalji utisak”. The review does not go public at once: it waits for a check.

admin-testimoniali-otvaranje.sr: U listi nalazimo utisak na čekanju i otvaramo ga.
admin-testimoniali-otvaranje.en: In the list we find the pending review and open it.

admin-testimoniali-odobrava.sr: {Kliknemo} „Odobri“. Tek odobren utisak se prikazuje na sajtu i ulazi u prosečnu ocenu koju vide pretraživači. Neprikladan se odbija.
admin-testimoniali-odobrava.en: We {click} “Odobri”. Only an approved review is shown on the site and counted in the average rating search engines see. An inappropriate one is rejected.
